pros: Marathon loop over the Cao Lanh Bridge and along the Tien River, AIMS-certified
About 20 aid stations on the 2025 marathon map, with fruit for runners
Six-and-a-half-hour marathon limit, closing at 10am in 2025
Shallow field: tenth place in 2025 was 2:58:18 for men and 3:45:26 for women
Full results with checkpoint splits and e-certificates for every distance
cons: Saturated air at the start: 26°C and 100% humidity at 3.30am in 2025
3.30am marathon start after a music night at the same square
Race kits only on the Saturday, with no collection afterwards
No refunds, and no transfers in the last three weeks before the 2025 race
name: VPBank Dat Sen Hong Music Marathon 2026
short_description: VPBank Dat Sen Hong Music Marathon 2026 is on Sunday 11 October 2026 at Van Mieu Square in Cao Lanh, Dong Thap, over 5 km, 10 km, the half marathon and the marathon.
ai_summary: VPBank Dat Sen Hong Music Marathon 2026 is the fifth edition of the Dong Thap race, organised by Nexus Sport Events with VPBank. The event runs from 9 to 11 October 2026 at Van Mieu Square in Cao Lanh ward, with race day on Sunday 11 October. The expected schedule starts the marathon at 3.30am and the half marathon at 4.30am, alongside 10 km and 5 km races, on a course the organisers describe as AIMS-standard.

core_facts.venue: Van Mieu Square, Cao Lanh ward
core_facts.organizer: Nexus Sport Events, with the Dong Thap provincial authorities and VPBank

faqs.question: What time do the marathon and half marathon start at VPBank Dat Sen Hong 2026?
faqs.answer: The expected schedule, updated 10 July 2026, runs the marathon from 3.30am to 10.00am and the half marathon from 4.30am to 7.45am on Sunday 11 October. The 10 km runs from 5.30am and the 5 km from 6.00am, and the organisers note that the schedule may change with conditions.

faqs.question: What are the age limits at VPBank Dat Sen Hong Music Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: Marathon runners must be at least 18 and half-marathon runners at least 16 on race day. The 10 km is open from age 10 and the 5 km from age six. Runners under 16 need a parent or guardian to sign a liability waiver before the race, or the organisers may refuse them.
